name: What should a homeowner prepare before room addition framing starts?

mainEntity.name: What should a homeowner prepare before room addition framing starts?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before framing begins, you should have architectural plans approved, local building permits pulled, and a cured concrete slab or foundation wall ready. You should also confirm window and door dimensions so framers construct accurate rough openings without needing later modifications. Additionally, clear exterior access pathways around your yard so lumber deliveries can be unloaded close to the build site. Preparing these specifications up front keeps the carpentry crew moving efficiently through wall assembly and roof tie-in.
acceptedAnswer.description: Homeowners need finalized architectural plans, building permits, a completed foundation, exact window/door rough opening dimensions, and clear yard access for lumber deliveries.
